proof_role: exact-revision Cargo inventory and evidence integrity
determinism: fixture tests deterministic; actual inventories pinned to Git commits, package, default features, Rust 1.92.0 and recorded host
resources: local CPU, Git, Python, Rust compiler and issue-owned target directory; no cloud or provider calls
release_gate: required issue acceptance; no runtime qualification or release approval
surfaces: actual Cargo discovery/build/list at both immutable revisions
verification of both complete transcript bundles
comparison of registered targets and enumerated cases
excluded: non-adl packages, benches/examples, non-default feature cases; metadata still reports excluded target registrations
review: independent exact-head and exact-result review required
